sloka: तां दृष्ट्वा रूपसम्पन्नां क्रीडन्तीं वरुणालये ।आविशत्परमो हर्षो वरुणं चोर्वशीकृते ।। ७.५६.१४ ॥
transliteration: tāṁ dṛṣṭvā rūpasampannāṁ krīḍantīṁ varuṇālaye ।āviśatparamo harṣo varuṇaṁ corvaśīkṛte ।। 7.56.14 ॥

translations.english: Having seen her, beautiful and playing in Varuna's abode, great joy entered Varuna because of Urvashi.
